task.description: Implement SCH-07 recurring timers in backend code according to src/design/sch07-recurring-timers.md. Required outcomes: parse ISO 8601 repeat expressions (R/PT..., Rn/PT...), persist recurrence state, fire and re-arm in the same transaction, terminate finite series at N firings, keep infinite series re-arming until instance termination, and preserve SCH-03 cancellation + SCH-05 missed-firing behavior. Apply any required additive migration(s) for timer recurrence fields. Keep transition.zig pure (no I/O).
acceptance_criteria: Recurring timer re-arm occurs in the same transaction as firing
R3 finite series stops after third fire; R/PT... continues until termination
No SQL interpolation of user input

result.summary: Implemented SCH-07 recurring timer support: ISO 8601 repeat expression parsing (R/PT..., Rn/PT...), recurrence-state persistence on timer rows, and transactional fire+re-arm in scheduler flow. Finite series stop at N firings and infinite series continue until instance cancellation/termination. Added additive migration for recurrence fields and constraints while keeping transition.zig pure.
